title: Four Principles, Five Learners
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: Four zones for the WCAG principles Perceivable, Operable, Understandable, and Robust, each pairing an example criterion with the learners it protects.

educational.topic: The four WCAG principles and the learners each one protects
learningObjectives: The learner will match each learner support to the WCAG principle it serves, and state one example criterion for each principle.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore a reference picture, then quiz on the same picture
keyQuestions: Which principle does the missing support belong to?
commonMisconceptions: Accessibility only matters for a few learners
Captions are only for deaf learners
A support belongs to exactly one principle
assessmentOpportunities: Which principle do captions for a deaf learner belong to?
Which principle asks that all functions work with a keyboard?
What does Robust ask about a custom control?

controls.name: Explore and Quiz buttons
controls.description: switch between exploring the poster and answering quiz questions.

controls.name: Poster zones
controls.description: hover or press to read about that part of the poster. In quiz mode a press is your answer.

controls.name: Try Again
controls.description: repeats the quiz after the last question.
